note: Campground among spruce and aspen a short walk from the playground, outdoor theatre, park office and Beauvais Lake, 11.5 km west of Pincher Creek on Hwy 507 then 8.5 km south on Hwy 775; gravel pads. Nine walk-in tent sites at the quieter south end of the lake. Potable water runs from the May long weekend to the end of September, weather dependent; in winter bring water and firewood. --Claude
